snov_prison.updateNotes: Police book prisoners in through a terminal that lists everyone serving, their remaining time and their confiscated property. Sentences can be interrupted for court appearances, and the resource now runs on QBCore as well as ESX.

snov_stretcher.updateNotes: Fixes loading and unloading the stretcher into vehicles.

snov_importcars.updateNotes: The dealership now buys vehicles from players and sells them to companies. Special vehicles such as police cars and limousines get their own storage tab. Run the included database update after installing.

snov_cuffs.updateNotes: All in-game text is now translatable, with German and English included. Item definitions and images for handcuffs, zipties, ankle cuffs, keys and pliers ship with the resource.

snov_sperrzone.updateNotes: Zones now clear NPCs automatically and can be set up per zone type.

snov_jobs.updateNotes: Illegal factions now pay their members out of the cash safe as a wage item that can be carried, traded, stolen and unpacked into cash - add the included ox_inventory entries before using it.

snov_farming.updateNotes: Depleted farming zones now show a clear message instead of a generic error. Hidden skills no longer appear in the skills menu.

snov_evidence.updateNotes: Fixes the exports used by other resources.

snov_license.updateNotes: Weapon training at Ammu-Nation is now a written theory exam instead of a simple purchase, graded on the spot with a result breakdown and a non-refundable attempt fee. Passing issues an official stamped certificate into the citizen's inventory, and an NPC reprints lost copies.

snov_mdt.updateNotes: Adds a bridge to snov_prison: the booking terminal can show what a person still has to serve, mark a sentence as served and pull the inmate photo.

snov_banking_billing.updateNotes: Bank cards show their item image again in the ATM card picker.

snov_documents.updateNotes: Filing cabinets and mailboxes are rebuilt with named compartments, drag to sort, search across the whole cabinet and one-button deposit. Adds citations as their own paper type and a global power-of-attorney template. Install together with snov_mdt 1.6.0 or newer.
